title: Borrow Checker Errors
story: The borrow checker is like a strict teacher — it points out every mistake before it becomes a disaster. Learning to read its errors is learning to write safe code.
why: Understanding common borrow checker errors is essential — they're the most frequent compile errors in XIOM and knowing how to fix them saves hours of frustration.
analogy: The borrow checker is a proofreader that catches every grammatical error. Fix the errors, and your code is guaranteed to be well-formed.
try_it: Take the 'cannot borrow as mutable and immutable' error. Try three different fixes: (1) scope the borrows, (2) clone the data, (3) restructure to avoid the conflict.
tips: Read borrow errors from the BOTTOM up — the last error is often the root cause
Add scope blocks { } to end borrows early when you need mixed access
Clone when you truly need independent copies for different operations
Restructure code to group reads together and writes together
common_mistakes: Ignoring borrow checker errors and adding .clone() everywhere — learn to restructure instead
Forgetting that loops extend borrow lifetimes — use scopes inside loops
Misreading error messages — the compiler tells you exactly which borrows conflict
